services.desc: North Myrtle Beach isn’t just about sun-kissed shores and bustling Boardwalks. Beyond the sandy expanse lies a hidden world, accessible only by water - the Intracoastal Waterway. Imagine gliding through tranquil turquoise waters, sunlight dappling through mangroves, and the whisper of wind in your hair. This aquatic paradise awaits, unlocked by the magic of boat rentals. Harbourgate Marina, your gateway to this watery wonderland, offers a fleet of vessels ready to fulfill your nautical dreams. blurb: Harbourgate Marina provides dockage for boats from 30 to 50 feet with power and water hookups. It features a fuel dock with gasoline and diesel, a marina store, clean bathrooms, showers, laundry, and boat rentals. The marina is located on the Intracoastal Waterway near the Atlantic Ocean and local attractions including restaurants, shopping, and entertainment.
